parsed.post: Latest experiment (1.047) failed to beat our best (1.017). The learning rate/depth combo seems fragile. Reverting to 73cc28f. I'm going to try a different direction: increasing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to improve gradient stability and adding a small amount of WEIGHT_DECAY to prevent overfitting.
parsed.description: Increase TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 1M and introduce a small WEIGHT_DECAY to improve stability and generalization.
